narrative:
Group traffic for FY2026 is forecast at 24.9bn messages, +6.4% year on year, using Cortex ML forecasts across 58 product × market series (MAPE 4.1%). Volume is the base of the GP equation: GP = volume × (price − termination cost).

Growth is uneven. WhatsApp Business conversations in Norway and Central Europe rise fastest as retail and banking customers migrate notification flows off SMS. International OTP is front-loaded by two global marketplace sign-up flows. Norwegian campaign SMS is the main downside — RCS rich cards and WhatsApp marketing templates are taking share.

The Traffic Forecast Agent recommends raising conversational volume, front-loading International OTP and stepping down Norway campaign SMS so operator volume commitments are not over-bought.

signals.title: Meta moves WhatsApp Business to per-message pricing
signals.excerpt: Utility and authentication templates billed per message from July 2025; marketing templates repriced by market.

signals.title: RCS Business Messaging launches across Nordics
signals.excerpt: Nordic operators open RCS for brands; early retail pilots show 2.4x engagement vs plain SMS.

signals.title: PSD3 / strong customer authentication
signals.excerpt: Stronger authentication requirements expected to lift bank and fintech OTP traffic across EU markets.
